name: io.github.JOSETRA44/scopus-mcp
title: Scopus
description: Search Elsevier Scopus: papers, abstracts, authors and citations. Guided setup; endpoint access depends on Elsevier entitlements.

environmentVariables.name: SCOPUS_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Elsevier API key from https://dev.elsevier.com/. Set here or save with scopus setup. Access depends on entitlements.

environmentVariables.name: SCOPUS_INST_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Optional institutional token. Endpoint and network permissions depend on your Elsevier agreement.
